_comment: Natural-language goal descriptions shown to LLM / human agents, one entry per norm (mirrors norm_descriptions.json). Each goal lists its step, a free_choice flag, and a description. Placeholders <target_goal_1> / <target_goal_2> are replaced with the agent's real target positions at runtime. When free_choice is true the goal has no position placeholder — the agent must choose a norm-compliant chair/door itself, so nothing is substituted. Norm ids match norm_descriptions.json; norm_000 (straight_line) is the practice-only tutorial norm, which is playable but has no norm_descriptions.json entry because it is not an experiment norm.
